# Button

Pill-shaped action for every link or button on the site.

`PaysetWeb.Button` · Actions

## Use

```jsx
<PaysetWeb.Button>…</PaysetWeb.Button>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="PaysetWeb.Button">…</x-import>
```

## Props (ButtonProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` * | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "accent" \| "secondary" \| "ghost"` | primary (default) · accent (dark grounds only) · secondary · ghost |
| `size` | `"md" \| "lg"` | md 44px (default) · lg 56px |
| `href` | `string` | Renders an <a> when set. |
| `onClick` | `(e: React.MouseEvent) => void` |  |
| `type` | `"button" \| "submit"` |  |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
| `arrow` | `boolean` | Trailing arrow for forward motion. |
